title: 动火作业
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/139_动火作业.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/139_动火作业/src.py

points.K7: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼前，旁边一个焊接火花图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laboratory building beside a large welding spark icon, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第二课：动火作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起一根手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger in warning, a small flame icon floating beside it.
shots.narration: 一粒火星，就可能烧掉一层楼。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊，施工工人准备切割排风管支架
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory building corridor, a contractor worker sets up an angle grinder under an exhaust duct bracket.
shots.narration: 实验楼改造，工人要切一个旧支架。

shots.scene: 支架下方堆着纸箱，隔壁实验室门开着，里面有溶剂柜
shots.prompt_en: Cardboard boxes are piled under the bracket and an open lab door shows a solvent cabinet inside.
shots.narration: 下面堆着纸箱，隔壁就是溶剂柜。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着工人，犹豫要不要说话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches the worker nervously, holding his notebook.
shots.narration: 阿杰心里打鼓：这样能行吗？

shots.scene: 老李走过来，举手示意先停
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and raises a hand to stop the worker before he starts.
shots.narration: 老李：等等，这是动火作业！

shots.scene: 明火、焊接、切割、打磨四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, an open flame torch, an arc welding spark, a cutting torch and an angle grinder throwing sparks. No text.
shots.narration: 用明火，或会产生火花的作业。

shots.scene: 焊、割、磨都在冒火花
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welding, cutting and grinding icons, each with a shower of sparks. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接、切割、打磨，都算动火。

shots.scene: 火花落到旁边的纸箱上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks from a grinder flying onto a nearby cardboard box, a small flame starting. No text.
shots.narration: 火花能点着周围的可燃物。

shots.scene: 酒精灯实验和维修切割两个场景对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: left, a student using a spirit lamp in a lab experiment; right, a worker cutting a pipe in a lab under renovation. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里施工维修动火，按动火管理。

shots.scene: 冷加工：螺栓连接、手锯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bolted bracket and a hand saw with a green tick, a welding torch set aside. No text.
shots.narration: 能用螺栓连接、冷加工，就别动火。

shots.scene: 部件拿到专用工作间去焊
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal part carried out of a lab building to a dedicated workshop with a welding booth. No text.
shots.narration: 能拿到专用工作间做，就别在楼里做。

shots.scene: 楼里动火的图标被缩小、加锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame icon inside a building outline, shrinking to a small icon with a lock beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 实验楼里，动火越少越好。

shots.scene: 火焰和爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire icon and an explosion icon side by side, the largest icons in the picture. No text.
shots.narration: 头号危害：火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 火花飞溅、滚落到远处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks bouncing and rolling far across a floor and down a gap. No text.
shots.narration: 火花会飞溅，还会滚落到很远。

shots.scene: 焊机漏电、焊接烟尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a welding machine with a lightning bolt and a cloud of welding fumes near a face. No text.
shots.narration: 设备漏电会触电，焊烟有毒伤肺。

shots.scene: 强光伤眼、电弧高温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a bright welding arc beside an eye and a thermometer at maximum. No text.
shots.narration: 电弧温度极高，强光和红外线伤眼。

shots.scene: 刚焊完的工件发红，手被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a freshly welded metal piece glowing, a bare hand reaching for it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 刚焊完的工件很烫，别用手摸。

shots.scene: 砂轮碎片、噪声和振动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a grinder without a guard with broken disc fragments, a noise wave icon and a vibration icon. No text.
shots.narration: 砂轮碎片伤人，还有噪声和振动。

shots.scene: 申请表从施工方送到后勤和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank hot work application passing from a contractor to the logistics office and the campus security office. No text.
shots.narration: 动火之前，先办动火审批。

shots.scene: 消防法的书和一张审批表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed law book and a blank approval form with a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 消防法要求：明火作业事先审批。

shots.scene: 焊工出示特种作业操作证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder in protective clothing holding up a blank operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接与热切割，必须持证上岗。

shots.scene: 学生拿焊枪被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student holding a welding torch alone, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 学生不得擅自动火。

shots.scene: 现场检查合格打勾后才开始
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist fully ticked at the work site, then a green start icon. No text.
shots.narration: 现场检查合格，才能开始作业。

shots.scene: 签发人对着三个勾选框
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer in front of three check boxes beside a blank hot work permit. No text.
shots.narration: 签发动火票前，先查三样。

shots.scene: 接收人的授权签字
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a signature line on a blank permit and a blank authorization card, with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 一查：接收人有没有授权签字。

shots.scene: 票上措施逐项落实
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a list of controls on a blank permit, each one matched to the real site with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 二查：票上的措施落实了没有。

shots.scene: 合格的监火人到位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained fire watch person standing at the site with a fire extinguisher, a tick above. No text.
shots.narration: 三查：合格的监火人到没到位。

shots.scene: 三项全勾才签发
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three check boxes all ticked, then a pen signing the permit. No text.
shots.narration: 三样都到位，才签发。

shots.scene: 工人把纸箱和溶剂瓶搬离作业点
shots.prompt_en: A worker carries cardboard boxes and solvent bottles away from the work spot on a trolley.
shots.narration: 第一步：移走易燃、可燃物。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把防火毯展开，盖严搬不走的仪器柜（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: hands unfolding a fire blanket and covering an instrument cabinet completely.
shots.narration: 搬不走的，用防火毯盖严。

shots.scene: 地面清扫干净
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor swept clean around the work spot, no debris, no puddles. No text.
shots.narration: 地面扫干净，不留杂物和积水。

shots.scene: 缝隙、孔洞被封堵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wall gaps and floor holes near the work spot sealed with fireproof covers. No text.
shots.narration: 附近的缝隙和孔洞，也要封堵。

shots.section_title: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊
shots.scene: 装过溶剂的桶被焊枪对着，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding torch pointed at an empty solvent drum, crossed out with a red cross. No text.
shots.narration: 装过易燃物的容器，不能直接焊。
overlay: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊

shots.section_title: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊
shots.scene: 空桶里残留蒸气的剖面图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of an empty drum showing vapor still inside, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 空桶里的残留蒸气，遇火会爆。

shots.section_title: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊
shots.scene: 在用的管线：停用、隔离、清洗、检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipeline being shut, isolated with a lock, flushed with water and tested with a detector, four steps. No text.
shots.narration: 在用的易燃设备，先停用隔离清洗。

shots.section_title: 易燃容器设备不能直接焊
shots.scene: 最高级别审批、专人监护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a permit with a red stamp and a fire watch person standing guard beside the equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 风险最高，按最严要求审批监护。

shots.scene: 狭窄的管道井、地下室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a narrow pipe shaft and a basement corner with poor air flow. No text.
shots.narration: 狭窄、通风差的地方，先测气体。

shots.scene: 专人用检测仪在作业点检测
shots.prompt_en: A trained technician holds a portable gas detector near the work spot before work starts.
shots.narration: 由专人检测可燃气体，合格才动火。

shots.scene: 作业中检测仪持续显示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas detector clipped near the work spot showing a steady green icon during work. No text.
shots.narration: 作业中情况变了，要重新检测。

shots.scene: 火花被焊接隔帘全部挡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welding curtains surrounding a work spot, sparks stopped inside. No text.
shots.narration: 火花要全部挡住，不让飞出去。

shots.scene: 焊接隔间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dedicated welding booth with fire resistant walls in a workshop. No text.
shots.narration: 能进焊接隔间做的，就进隔间做。

shots.scene: 高处切割，火花往下落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker cutting on a platform, sparks falling down toward the floor below. No text.
shots.narration: 高处动火，火花会往下掉。

shots.scene: 下方铺防火毯、放接火盆
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire blanket spread on the floor and a metal spark tray under the cutting point. No text.
shots.narration: 下方铺防火毯，用接火盆接住。

shots.scene: 上下各一名监火人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one fire watch person on the platform and another on the floor below. No text.
shots.narration: 上下都要有人看火。

shots.scene: 监火人站在作业点旁，手握灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A fire watch person in a reflective vest stands beside the work spot holding a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 可能起火，就要派监火人。

shots.scene: 监火人只盯火花，不干别的
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fire watch person watching where sparks land, a phone and a toolbox beside him crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 专人专职，盯住火花去向。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把灭火器放到作业点旁，看压力表在绿区（特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand placing a fire extinguisher beside a work area and pointing at its pressure gauge.
shots.narration: 灭火器放在手边，先查压力。

shots.scene: 灭火毯、消防水带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire blanket pouch and a fire hose reel near the work spot. No text.
shots.narration: 灭火毯、消防水源也要备好。

shots.scene: 监火人发现火情，喊停、报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the fire watch person raising a stop hand and calling on a phone with an alarm icon. No text.
shots.narration: 发现火情，立即叫停并报警。

shots.scene: 实验室里溶剂、气瓶被移出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: solvent bottles and a gas cylinder being moved out of a lab before hot work. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室动火，先移走易燃试剂。

shots.scene: 关闭燃气、特气阀门并挂牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas line valve closed with a tag and a lock in a lab. No text.
shots.narration: 关停相关气源，挂牌提示。

shots.scene: 排风管有化学残留的剖面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a fume hood exhaust duct with residue inside and a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 排风管里有残留，先清理再动。

shots.scene: 烟感报警器图标与审批章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a smoke detector icon with a stamped approval form, a hand covering the detector alone crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 消防设施怎么处理，按规定报批。

shots.scene: 存放易燃物的实验室门口，火焰图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab door with a flammable storage cabinet inside, a flame icon at the door crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃物没处理好，就不能动火。

shots.scene: 火星藏在墙缝里冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny ember hidden in a wall gap, a thin wisp of smoke rising. No text.
shots.narration: 焊完不等于结束，火星会阴燃。

shots.scene: 检查缝隙和隔墙背面
shots.prompt_en: The fire watch person checks wall gaps and the back side of a partition with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 检查缝隙、楼板下和隔墙背面。

shots.scene: 时钟：继续守一段时间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock beside the fire watch person still standing at the finished work site. No text.
shots.narration: 继续守一段时间，时长按本校规定。

shots.scene: 过一阵再查一遍，确认无火离开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a second check with a tick, then the fire watch person leaving and switching off the light. No text.
shots.narration: 过一阵再查一遍，确认无火再离开。

shots.scene: 审批章、持证卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a stamped permit and an operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 能不动火不动火，动火先审批。

shots.scene: 清走可燃物、挡住火花
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, combustibles moved away and a welding curtain. No text.
shots.narration: 清走可燃物，挡住火花，先测气体。

shots.scene: 监火人、灭火器、时钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a fire watch person, a fire extinguisher and a clock. No text.
shots.narration: 监火人全程看守，完工再查余火。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在井口围栏外挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a fenced manhole opening and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：受限空间作业。
